      "comment": "needs-a-human: source inspection supports a missing graph collection-removal audit event; focused executable RED is still required.

Inspected upstream a27b439b2dc96cf0bd0bf8f76ab33ff6d5664b25. BasicCollectionDecomposer.decomposeRemove schedules SQL and post-remove handling but never invokes the audit collection contributor, unlike recreate and update. AuditCollectionMutationPlanContributor currently has no owner-deletion intent; GraphAuditMutationCollector derives changes from CollectionAuditSupport.resolveChanges.

Do not copy the legacy null-snapshot convention into graph support: resolveChanges(collection, null) means ADD. Legacy RemoveCoordinatorAudit instead initializes before bulk removal and uses a dedicated writer which emits DEL. PostCollectionRemoveHandling calls CollectionEntry.afterAction, so deletion state and snapshot timing must be preserved before cleanup.

Blast radius: hibernate-core collection decomposition and shared collection audit semantics. Two-way: a narrow internal correction can preserve public APIs and schema. Persisted audit rows are observable, so verify exact row/revision behavior before publication.

Possible approach: represent owner-deletion intent at the existing collection mutation boundary and reuse the smallest appropriate CollectionAuditSupport semantic helper. Keep owner deletion distinct from collection replacement/recreate; preserve indexed/map/identifier-bag row identity, lazy initialization and empty-collection behavior. Do not add a second parallel audit pipeline or blanket clear collections.

Use the existing org.hibernate.temporal.audit.collection tests as mapping and changeset conventions. First add one minimal audited Set<String> owner persist/delete regression with graph and legacy explicitly selected, through Hibernate APIs. Obtain focused Actions RED on unchanged production, then the smallest fix and GREEN. Add initialized/lazy and replacement/update controls according to the changed boundary, not a full matrix. No tests or builds were run during this source-only triage, and no code was changed.

Jira was New and Unassigned. Exact and semantic all-state PR searches found no matching active fix. Adjacent HHH-20641 PR13870 changes owner-resolution/override logic; recheck it before editing related helpers and avoid duplicating that work. No duplicate issues were closed.

Open questions: executable failure and exact minimal correction; initialization timing for unloaded/null wrappers; retention of original row identities and revision counts. The next step is the focused RED evidence gate, not a claim of a completed fix."
